Prior to the open debate, we will hold the media stake in of the signatories of the shared commitments on WPS plus other interested member states. Moving on, we will also seek to ensure meaningful participation by civil societies representatives in a number of our meetings, like emerging technologies, CAC, WPS, Haiti, and Yemen. Another important part of our program will be our engagement with Africa Union, and I want to emphasize on this.
